correctness.rationale: The Markov transition matrix is column stochastic because outdegree at j plus incoming wins against j equals n-1, and stationary solution exists uniquely in the tournament setting. The Slater criterion maximizes arcs consistent with a linear order. Independently rebuilt all labeled tournaments n=1,…,5 and computed Slater maxima by direct all n! ordering enumeration, and exact Markov winners by rational Gaussian elimination; the original source additionally supplies independent subset-DP and matrix-tree-cofactor implementations, each inspected. The exact discrepancy counts are 0 through n=4, and 240 at n=5 of 1024, with the 240 all satisfying MA⊊SL; the two strict size layers (3,1) and (2,1) each comprise 120 labeled cases. Independently canonicalized these under all 120 relabelings to find two size-120 isomorphism classes, so automorphism order one; rational stationary vectors (9,3,1,13,17)/43 and (1/4,1/12,1/6,1/8,3/8) have the asserted unique maxima. Enumeration is complete for n≤5 only, not larger tournaments.

However its printed comparison table reports onset indices, not all 240 labeled five-vertex mismatch instances, universal MA⊊SL containment, two sizes and exact two isomorphism classes. A separation threshold of six implies only nonempty intersection at order five, substantially weaker than universal strict containment.
